title: Innovation starts like art — seeing what others overlook
hook: A Kaskazi event reminder: creativity, technology, and problem-solving share the same foundation — imagination.

title: Scaling without fixing infrastructure is a business risk
hook: Multi-site growth, uptime pressure, and security at scale — why infrastructure decisions are leadership decisions, not only IT tickets.
